name: ContributionHeatmap
description: A GitHub-style calendar heatmap whose cells pop in along a diagonal wave, shaded in five intensity levels mixed from a single accent color. Includes month and weekday labels, a Less/More legend and a hover/keyboard tooltip, driven by seeded deterministic demo data or your own daily counts.
a11yNotes: The cell grid is one focusable role="img" whose aria-label states the total and the date range. Arrow keys move day by day (Up/Down) and week by week (Left/Right), Home/End jump to the first/last day; each move shows the tooltip and announces "n contributions on Day, Mon d, yyyy" in a polite live region, Escape clears. Labels and legend are aria-hidden decoration. Focus is shown with a 2px outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion the cells appear without the pop-in.

propsApi.name: data
propsApi.description: Explicit daily counts, oldest first, aligned so the last entry falls on endDate. Overrides the generated demo data.

propsApi.name: endDate
propsApi.description: Last day of the calendar as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); a fixed date keeps server and client output identical.

propsApi.name: seed
propsApi.description: Seed for the deterministic demo data.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Base color; levels 1–4 are color-mixed from it over the empty-cell surface.

propsApi.name: unit
propsApi.description: Noun used in the header, tooltip and announcements.

propsApi.name: showLabels
propsApi.description: Show month labels above and Mon/Wed/Fri labels to the left.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Per-diagonal delay of the cell pop-in, in ms.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
